name: Easy Slow Cooker "Beef Enchilada" Meatballs with Avocado-Ranch Salad & Tortilla Chips

instructions.primary_message: Place tortilla chips in a medium bowl and crush with a wooden spoon to create coarse crumbs (you should have about a ⅔-cup of crumbs).

Wash and dry green onions and cilantro. Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl with the tortilla crumbs along with beef, eggs, taco seasoning, and salt. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
½ small bunch cilantro
680 g lean ground beef
3 tbsp taco seasoning
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the beef mixture into meatballs and arrange in an even layer in the bottom of a 4-quart slow cooker insert.
Place salsa, tomato sauce, and oregano in a small bowl, then stir to combine. Pour sauce over the meatballs, then cover and cook until meatballs are cooked through, HIGH for about 2 hours.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups salsa
213 ml tomato sauce
1 tsp oregano, dried

instructions.primary_message: When the meatballs are done, uncover, then sprinkle with cheese. Re-cover and continue to cook until the cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place the contents of the salad kits (including toppings and dressing) in a large bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (357 g) bag Southwest chopped salad kit

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide meatballs, salad, and additional tortilla chips between plates. Enjoy!
